0022600007.text: The Thunder, now 1-0 and first in the Northwest, host Denver in their second game of the season, while the Nuggets have yet to play a 2026-27 game. There have been no meetings between the teams so far this season, Oklahoma City won the 2025-26 series 3-1, and Denver won the most recent matchup 127-107 in Denver on April 10 in the regular season. Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), while Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and has Spencer Jones listed as day-to-day with a hamstring issue and a game-time decision.
